biggest_catch: Payout is in Tango Card digital gift cards (not cash) and study availability is irregular - new slots post each weeknight, so earnings depend on what's available.
catches: Compensation is in digital gift cards via Tango Card, not cash - redeemable at various retailers/restaurants or donated
Pay is strictly $12/hr in $1-per-5-minute units; short surveys pay only a few dollars
New studies/time slots post each weeknight by 8pm CT - irregular availability
Zoom (highest-paying) studies require passing the Zoom Prerequisite Study ($3/10-15 min) and appointments Tue-Fri 11am-4pm CT
Compensation emails typically arrive 3-4 business days after participation, not instantly

steps: Sign up for a Virtual Lab account (login info arrives within 1-2 business days)
Complete the prescreen survey when you first log in
Browse and sign up for paid surveys you are eligible for
Optionally complete the Zoom Prerequisite Study ($3/10-15 min) to unlock higher-paying Zoom studies
Complete studies; receive Tango Card gift-card compensation email within 3-4 business days
